WHAT YOU CAN DO
  - Use these skyboxes and layers in personal and commercial projects, in
    any number of projects, royalty free.
  - Modify, recolor, scale and edit them however you like.
  - Use them in games, apps, video, renders, prototypes and client work.
  - Attribution is not required, though it is always appreciated.

WHAT YOU CANNOT DO
  - Resell, redistribute or give away the image files themselves, either as-is
    or modified, as a skybox or texture pack, library or collection.

HOW THE ART WAS MADE
  Every image is generated procedurally by original code. It contains no
  photos and no third-party art.

NO WARRANTY
